script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

A cluttered, cramped living room in a small apartment. We see JASON (mid-30s), a frazzled man, sitting on an old, worn couch. He's surrounded by papers, empty coffee cups, and takeout containers.

JASON
(to himself)
I can't do this anymore. I need a change.

Suddenly, the door bursts open, and his wife, MIA (late 20s), enters carrying a stack of papers.

MIA
(surprised)
Jason, you're supposed to be at the office!

JASON
(desperate)
I can't take it anymore, Mi. I can't keep living this mundane life. I need something more.

MIA
(skeptical)
More? Like what?

Jason stands up and grabs a worn, old book from a nearby shelf. He flips through the pages, revealing crude illustrations of towering castles, fierce dragons, and brave knights.

JASON
(excited)
I want to be a knight, Mi. I want to live an adventure-filled life.

MIA
(laughs)
You're thirty-five years old, Jason. You can't just up and become a knight.

JASON
(determined)
Why not? I'll find a way.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Jason sits in a crowded coffee shop, sipping on a coffee and staring intently at an ad in the local paper. An older WOMAN (late 50s), dressed in medieval clothing, sits down across from him.

WOMAN
(friendly)
Excuse me, young man. That looks like an interesting ad.

JASON
(startled)
Oh, sorry. Yes, it is. It's for a local reenactment group. I've always been fascinated by the medieval era.

WOMAN
(smiling)
And what brings you to this fascination now?

JASON
(frustrated)
I'm tired of my mundane life. I need something more, something exciting.

WOMAN
(understanding)
Ah, the call of adventure. I used to feel the same way when I was your age. But remember, adventure isn't always glamorous or easy. It requires hard work and dedication.

JASON
(determined)
I'm ready for that challenge.

INT. REENACTMENT CAMP - DAY

Jason, now wearing a tunic and carrying a wooden sword, stands amidst a group of other reenactors, all dressed in medieval clothing. They're preparing for a battle reenactment.

JASON
(excited)
This is it! This is the life I've always wanted.

An older MAN (mid-40s), the group leader, approaches Jason.

MAN
(disapproving)
You may be enthusiastic, but you need to learn the basics before you can fight in a battle.

JASON
(eager)
I'll do whatever it takes.

INT. REENACTMENT CAMP - NIGHT

Jason sits in the dark, practicing his swordplay by the dim light of a lantern. He's determined to prove himself to the group and live the adventurous life he's always dreamed of.

INT. REENACTMENT BATTLEFIELD - DAY

The day of the battle reenactment arrives, and Jason, now a respected member of the group, stands amongst his comrades as they prepare to face their opponents.

MAN
(serious)
Remember, the safety of your comrades depends on your ability to fight effectively.

JASON
(confident)
I'm ready.

The battle rages on, and Jason fights valiantly, demonstrating his newfound skills. In the chaos of the battle, he saves the life of a fellow knight, earning the respect and admiration of his comrades.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Jason returns home, covered in dirt and bruises, but filled with a newfound sense of pride and purpose. Mi greets him with a warm smile.

MIA
(proud)
You look... different.

JASON
(satisfied)
I've found something more, Mi. Something that gives my life meaning and purpose.

MIA
(happy)
I'm glad you're happy, Jason.

FADE OUT.
